prompt.project_info: Create a photorealistic 3:4 bedroom mirror selfie of an approved adult woman.
prompt.main_subject: Approved adult Chinese woman with a youthful but clearly adult appearance, realistic skin texture, casual grey loungewear, and neat white crew socks, seated comfortably on a slightly messy bed while holding a smartphone.
prompt.composition_elements: Mirror selfie with cozy bedroom, soft bedding, natural relaxed posture, side window, and a softly blurred background; keep the person clearly adult and avoid intimate framing.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Warm golden-hour light enters from a side window, creating a moody cinematic bedroom atmosphere with natural shadows and gentle bokeh.
prompt.technical_specs: Photorealistic 35mm-style mirror selfie, 3:4 aspect ratio, sharp subject reflection, realistic skin, natural depth of field, high-resolution detail.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: A photorealistic 3:4 mirror selfie of an approved adult Chinese woman with realistic skin texture, wearing casual grey loungewear and neat white crew socks, seated comfortably on a cozy slightly messy bed in her bedroom and holding a smartphone. Soft golden-hour light streams from a side window, creating a warm moody cinematic atmosphere. Keep the bedroom, bedding, relaxed adult subject, 35mm perspective, sharp mirror reflection, softly blurred background, natural skin, and realistic high-resolution detail.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, underage, childlike, youthful minor appearance, lingerie, exposed underwear, sexualized pose, nudity, extra limbs, deformed hands, blur, noise, watermark, text, logo, cartoon, anime, plastic skin, public figure likeness.
